standalone_functions.name: get_db
standalone_functions.docstring: Yields a clean database connection from our managed thread pool.
standalone_functions.source_code:
def get_db():
    """Yields a clean database connection from our managed thread pool."""
    conn = db_pool.connection()
    try:
        yield conn
    finally:
        conn.close()

standalone_functions.name: reverse_existing_transaction
standalone_functions.docstring: Automatically compiles and posts an exact mathematical counter-reversal for a past transaction.
standalone_functions.source_code:
@app.post('/transactions/{transaction_id}/reverse', status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def reverse_existing_transaction(transaction_id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID=Depends(get_current_user_id), conn=Depends(get_db)):
    """Automatically compiles and posts an exact mathematical counter-reversal for a past transaction."""
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    lookup_query = '\n        SELECT j.account_id, j.description, j.amount \n        FROM journal_entries j\n        JOIN accounts a ON j.account_id = a.id\n        WHERE j.transaction_id = %s AND a.user_id = %s;\n    '
    try:
        cursor.execute(lookup_query, (str(transaction_id), str(user_id)))
        lines = cursor.fetchall()
        if not lines:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Target transaction context not found or access is unauthorized.')
        new_reversal_id = uuid.uuid4()
        for line in lines:
            account_id = line[0]
            original_description = line[1]
            original_amount = line[2]
            reversed_amount = -original_amount
            reversal_description = f'REVERSAL OF [{transaction_id}]: {original_description}'
            cursor.execute('INSERT INTO journal_entries (transaction_id, account_id, description, amount) \n                   VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s);', (str(new_reversal_id), str(account_id), reversal_description, reversed_amount))
        conn.commit()
        return {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Transaction historically canceled out via immutable counter-entry.', 'reversal_transaction_id': new_reversal_id}
    except HTTPException:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        conn.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f'Reversal compiler failed: {str(e)}')
    finally:
        cursor.close()
